tasks.description: Converts Markdown documents with front matter to a single HTML page and summarises the conversion. Use when asked to convert a folder of Markdown documents to HTML.
tasks.intent: Convert Markdown documents to one HTML page with a summary.

tasks.description: Extracts front matter metadata from Markdown documents with per-author and per-tag counts. Use when asked to extract the metadata of a folder of Markdown documents.
tasks.intent: Extract front matter metadata from Markdown documents.

tasks.description: Lists citation keys used in Markdown documents and checks them against a bibliography file. Use when asked for the citation keys used across a set of documents.
tasks.intent: List citation keys and check them against the bibliography.
